info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Lookups API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

item.name: Factset Get Accounts and Sub-directories in a Directory

variable.description: (Required) The directory to get the accounts and sub-directories in

request.description: This endpoint looks up all ACCT and ACTM files and sub-directories in a given directory.

response.name: Expected response, returns a list of accounts and directories
